lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate16
: S-See?! This is romantic dialogue, is it not?! You do see this as a date after all!
lines.zh: : 看、看吧？！这就是恋爱台词，不是吗？！您果然把这当成约会了！

lines.en: : Oh my God, can you two shut up?!
lines.zh: : 我的天，你们俩能闭嘴吗？！

lines.en: : Ignore her, Sir. ‘Tis just jealousy and I know it well.
lines.zh: : 别理她，先生。那不过是嫉妒罢了，这我可太熟了。

lines.en: : Now, about this game-
lines.zh: : 那么，关于这个游戏——

lines.en: : Are you not worried about being out here with me, Molly?
lines.zh: : 跟我一起在外面，你就不担心吗，Molly？

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate17
: Worried? Why would I be worried? Compensated dating is extremely normal in places such as this and the likelihood of someone believing I’m just your {i}hired{/i} girlfriend is rather-
lines.zh: : 担心？我为什么要担心？援助交际在这种地方再正常不过了，别人认为我只是您{i}雇来{/i}的女朋友的可能性相当——

lines.en: : Not about the age thing. About going out on a date with me when you’re fully aware of how little time I’ve spent with everyone else in the class as of late.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是年龄那件事。是你明知道我最近跟班上其他人几乎没怎么相处，还愿意跟我出来约会这件事。

lines.en: : Aren’t you at least somewhat scared that we might bump into one of them and that you’ll have to figure out a way to explain this away while {i}I{/i} can just slink back into the shadows?
lines.zh: : 你就一点都不怕我们撞上她们中的某一个、你得想办法解释清楚，而{i}我{/i}只要重新溜回阴影里就行了？

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate18
: Hm...That would be somewhat problematic now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这么一想，那确实有点麻烦。

lines.en: : But I guess I was just so excited to do something like this with you that I hadn’t bothered thinking about it.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，我大概是太兴奋能跟您做这种事了，根本没顾上想这些。

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate19
: I sincerely doubt anyone would assume that we’re {i}together{/i} if they saw us like this though, Sir. I don’t think many of them see me as a viable partner for you at all.
lines.zh: : 不过我真心怀疑，就算有人看到我们这样，也不会觉得我们是{i}一对{/i}，先生。我觉得她们没多少人会认为我配得上您。

lines.en: : Is that nerd Molly speaking or self-conscious Molly speaking? Because one of those is unpopular by design and the other one just over-thinks things.
lines.zh: : 现在说话的是宅女 Molly，还是自卑的 Molly？因为前者按设定就是不受欢迎，后者只是想太多。

lines.en: : Despite what my alts would indicate- I am but one character, Sir. And those are both aspects of my person.
lines.zh: : 尽管我的那些小号看起来像另一回事——我只是同一个角色，先生。那两者都是我这个人的不同侧面。

lines.en: : There is not {i}one{/i} reason the others would not see me as a viable candidate, there are many. And granted, they are warranted.
lines.zh: : 她们不把我当成合适人选的理由不是{i}一条{/i}，而是很多条。而且说实话，那些理由都站得住脚。

lines.en: : But if there’s anything I know about romance, which there is not, it’s that {i}anyone{/i} has a chance with {i}anyone{/i} if they try hard enough.
lines.zh: : 不过要说我对恋爱有什么了解——其实我一点都不懂——那就是，只要足够努力，{i}任何人{/i}和{i}任何人{/i}都有可能在一起。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s terrible advice and definitely not true.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这建议糟透了，而且绝对不是真的。

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate20
: Which is why I clarified that I know nothing of this form of magic.
lines.zh: : 所以我才先声明过，我对这种魔法一无所知。

lines.en: : Did you know I went on a date just like this with Rin once?
lines.zh: : 你知道我曾经跟 Rin 有过一次一模一样的约会吗？

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate21
: Is now really the best time to brag, Sir?
lines.zh: : 现在真的是炫耀的好时机吗，先生？

lines.en: : I’m not trying to brag, just drawing similarities. For example, do you think the others see {i}her{/i} as a viable partner for me?
lines.zh: : 我不是在炫耀，只是找找共同点。比如说，你觉得其他人会把{i}她{/i}当成我的合适伴侣吗？

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate22
: I’d say so, Sir. Your camaraderie is noted by everyone, and I’m not sure anyone would be surprised if the two of you were to become more {i}involved{/i} one day.
lines.zh: : 我觉得会，先生。你们俩的默契所有人都看在眼里。如果有一天你们关系{i}更进一步{/i}，我想没人会感到意外。

lines.en: : That’s exactly what I mean.
lines.zh: : 我说的就是这个意思。

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate21
: So you {i}are{/i} bragging.
lines.zh: : 所以您{i}就是在{/i}炫耀。
: 不是……

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate22
: I just mean that you two are very similar. And if you think everyone can picture {i}her{/i} with me, why would it be any different for you?
lines.zh: : 我只是说你们俩很像。既然你觉得大家都能想象{i}她{/i}跟我在一起，那换成你又有什么不一样？

lines.en: : You’re both perverted, nerdy weirdos at the end of the day. And even if people think those qualities are a little more exaggerated in you, which they are, who cares?
lines.zh: : 说到底，你们俩都是又好色又宅的怪人。就算别人觉得你身上这些特质夸张了点——确实夸张了点——那又怎样？

lines.en: : So...the moral is to believe in myself and not care about what other people think of me?
lines.zh: : 所以……重点是相信自己、别在乎别人怎么看我？

lines.en: : No. If that were the moral, I wouldn’t have to say anything because I believe you already {i}do{/i} that.
lines.zh: : 不是。如果重点真是这个，我就什么都不用说了，因为我相信你{i}已经{/i}做到了。

lines.en: : The moral is that you {i}should{/i} care. Because it will make proving them wrong feel infinitely better.
lines.zh: : 重点是你{i}应该{/i}在乎。因为这样等你要证明他们错了的时候，感觉会好上一万倍。

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate23
: Wording it that way makes it sound as if {i}you{/i} believe in us, Sir.
lines.zh: : 您这么一说，听起来就像{i}您{/i}相信我们一样，先生。

lines.en: : What I believe doesn’t matter. I’m a spineless husk of a man who will accept any affection thrown at him because that’s all I’ve ever done throughout my time on this planet.
lines.zh: : 我相信什么不重要。我就是个没骨头的空壳男人，谁扔过来的感情我都接，因为我在这颗星球上从头到尾就只会干这个。

lines.en: : Well...you are my favorite spineless husk of all, Sir.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那您也是我最喜欢的那个没骨头的空壳，先生。

lines.en: scene black
: N-Now! About this game...
lines.zh: : 那、那么！关于这个游戏……

lines.en: Molly and I spend the next couple hours playing various arcade games before leaving to go get lunch.
lines.zh: 接下来的两个小时里，Molly 和我玩了各种街机游戏，然后才离开去吃午饭。

lines.en: Conveniently, that lunch is located directly upstairs at a cafe built into the gaming center.
lines.zh: 巧的是，那顿午饭就在楼上——这家游戏中心里自带的一家咖啡馆。

lines.en: So we return to the ground floor for more arcade stuff once we’re done there and that kills {i}another{/i} couple hours.
lines.zh: 吃完之后我们又回到一楼继续玩街机，就这么{i}又{/i}消磨了两个小时。

lines.en: And honestly, I didn’t even know it was possible to spend so much time in an arcade.
lines.zh: 老实说，我以前都不知道在街机厅里居然能待这么久。

lines.en: But when you’ve got someone as passionate about this stuff as Molly, it’s normally fine if you get caught in the current.
lines.zh: 但当身边有个像 Molly 这样对这玩意儿充满热情的人，被这股水流卷着走通常也没什么不好。

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate24
But the thing with currents is that they can be dangerous if you don’t approach them with caution.
lines.zh: 但水流的麻烦在于，如果你不小心靠近，它也会很危险。

lines.en: In fact, in most cases, it’s probably best to leave the more violent ones alone. For if you’re not whisked away to somewhere you don’t want to go, you may very well drown.
lines.zh: 事实上，大多数情况下，最好别去招惹那些更凶猛的。因为就算你没被卷到不想去的地方，也很有可能会淹死。

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate25
scene mollyarcadedate24
I can feel my feet beginning to slip, and I can’t find anything to latch onto that will not break the moment I touch it. And that’s my fault.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到脚底开始打滑，却找不到任何一碰就不断掉的东西可以抓住。而这都是我的错。

lines.en: Under most circumstances, it {i}is{/i} normally fine getting caught in the current. But no matter how many times I learn not to, I can’t help but fight back at the water.
lines.zh: 大多数情况下，被水流卷走{i}本来{/i}也没什么。可不管我学过多少次别这么做，我还是忍不住要跟水搏斗。

lines.en: All that does is tire me out and drag me under. But again, that {i}could{/i} be fine if you have someone like Molly acting as a lifeguard. You just have to be careful not to drag her down with you.
lines.zh: 那样做只会让我精疲力竭、被拖到水下。不过话说回来，如果你身边有个像 Molly 这样的救生员，那{i}也没关系{/i}。只是你得小心，别把她一起拖下水。

lines.en: : Sir-
lines.zh: : 先生——

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate25
scene mollyarcadedate24
I flew too close to the sun again.
lines.zh: 我又一次飞得离太阳太近了。

lines.en: : Thank you for today. Really.
lines.zh: : 谢谢您今天。真的。

lines.en: : Because even if you didn’t enjoy yourself, it meant a lot to me. And if there is anything {i}I{/i} can do to make you feel any better, all you have to do is say the word.
lines.zh: : 因为就算您玩得不开心，今天对我来说也意义重大。如果有什么是{i}我{/i}能做的、能让您好受一点的事，您只要开口就行。

lines.en: SAY THE WORD.
lines.zh: 快开口。

lines.en: : Molly-
lines.zh: : Molly——

lines.en: COME ON.
lines.zh: 快啊。

lines.en: : Things have been pretty terrible lately. You know that.
lines.zh: : 最近的日子挺糟糕的。这你知道。

lines.en: UGHHHHH HERE WE GO AGAIN.
lines.zh: 呜呜呜呜，又来了。

lines.en: : I know, Sir.
lines.zh: : 我知道，先生。

lines.en: : And, to be completely honest with you, there’s probably nothing you can do to help that doesn’t involve selling your soul.
lines.zh: : 而且，跟您说实话，大概除了出卖灵魂之外，您也没什么办法能帮到我。

lines.en: : I have collected thousands upon thousands of souls. Just ask the Lord of Cinder.
lines.zh: : 我收集过成千上万的灵魂。不信去问薪王。

lines.en: : What I mean to say is that this is the peak of what we can accomplish together. We’ve gotten everything we possibly can out of this date.
lines.zh: : 我想说的是，这已经是我们能一起达到的顶点了。这场约会能榨出来的东西，我们都榨干了。

lines.en: : But you’ve gotten nothing, Sir. And I’ve gotten to experience something I may never get the chance to again once the rest of the class comes back into the picture.
lines.zh: : 可您什么都没得到，先生。而我体验到的东西，等班上其他人重新回到画面里之后，我可能再也没有机会体验第二次。

lines.en: : Molly-
lines.zh: : Molly——

lines.en: : Don’t fight me on this one, Sir. I may be level one in love, but that’s only because I’ve been grinding loneliness for so long.
lines.zh: : 这次别跟我争了，先生。我在爱情上也许只有一级，但那只是因为我在“孤独”这件事上刷了太久的经验。

lines.en: : You won’t ever actually be my {i}boyfriend.{/i} And I won’t ever actually be your {i}girlfriend.{/i} But that’s okay, because we can still {i}be{/i} together in our own way.
lines.zh: : 您永远不会真的成为我的{i}男朋友{/i}。我也永远不会真的成为您的{i}女朋友{/i}。但那没关系，因为我们还是可以用我们自己的方式{i}在一起{/i}。

lines.en: : That doesn’t need to make sense to anyone else. But in my life, nothing has ever really {i}needed{/i} to make sense to anyone else.
lines.zh: : 这不需要对任何人讲得通。反正我这辈子，从来没有哪件事真的{i}需要{/i}对别人讲得通。

lines.en: : And that’s what I both love and hate about you.
lines.zh: : 而这就是我既爱您又恨您的地方。

lines.en: : Aye...but do you know what I both love and hate about you, Sir?
lines.zh: : 是……那您知道，您身上我既爱又恨的是什么吗，先生？

lines.en: : What’s that?
lines.zh: : 是什么？

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate26
: That even though I constantly annoy you...or confuse you...or make you feel terrible with my unwanted advances...
lines.zh: : 那就是，尽管我总是烦您……或者把您搞糊涂……或者用我那些您根本不想要的示好让您难受……

lines.en: : You still cherish me.
lines.zh: : 您依然珍惜我。

lines.en: : You may jest...and say mean things about how much of a nerd I am, or...poke fun at the way I’ve lived my life. But that’s just it, Sir. It’s all in jest. So {i}of course{/i} I love that.
lines.zh: : 您会开玩笑……会说我有多宅、说些刻薄话，或者……拿我的生活方式打趣。但问题就在这里，先生。那全都是玩笑。所以我{i}当然{/i}喜欢这一点。

lines.en: : But if any of that’s true, and I’m not claiming it is...why would you hate it? Because I don’t think many people would take exception to any of those things.
lines.zh: : 可如果那些都是真的——我倒没说它是真的——您为什么会恨它呢？我想大多数人不会对其中任何一点介意。

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate27
: It’s because it conflicts with something else I want, Sir.
lines.zh: : 因为它和我想要的另一样东西冲突了，先生。

lines.en: : It is nice to be cherished, yes.
lines.zh: : 被珍惜的感觉当然很好。

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate28
: But sometimes I wish that you’d just break me already.
lines.zh: : 可有时候我真希望您干脆把我弄坏算了。

lines.en: oh shit.
lines.zh: 哦操。

lines.en: : Molly-
lines.zh: : Molly——

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate24
: It’s because of Halloween, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是因为万圣节那件事，对吧？

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate25
scene mollyarcadedate24
: Put it behind you, Sir.
lines.zh: : 把它放下吧，先生。

lines.en: scene mollyarcadedate25
scene mollyarcadedate24
: Come back to the dorms with me.
lines.zh: : 跟我回宿舍吧。

lines.en: scene black
: We can do something for {i}you{/i} next.
lines.zh: : 接下来我们可以为{i}您{/i}做点什么。

lines.en: $ mollyspring1 = True
$ molly_love += 1
{i}Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Molly 的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump mollyspring2
